title: ChunkPreviewJobCreateRequest
description: Multipart request for a chunk preview job. Page normalization rules: if both pages are missing use 1..lastPage; only startPage => startPage..lastPage; only endPage => 1..endPage; both => startPage..endPage.

useCharBasedSplit.description: Preview-only override. If true, apply char-based splitting using chunkSize/chunkOverlap.

chunkSize.description: Chunk size in characters when char-based split is enabled.

chunkOverlap.description: Chunk overlap in characters when char-based split is enabled.
